name: 98662 · Vancouver, WA
findings: ZIP 98662 (Vancouver) has 88 nonprofit organizations. 43 of them (49%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 32 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (35% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 98662 (Vancouver) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
